title: Amazing family photos even with a 2-year-old!
text:
We booked this photoshoot with my wife and our 2-year-old child, and it was truly wonderful!
We were a little worried about how our toddler would do during the shoot, but our photographer, Cristina Roldán, was fantastic with kids and kept our child entertained and smiling the entire time. Thanks to her, we got so many natural, heartwarming family photos with the Sagrada Familia in the background.
The quality of the photos is incredible, and they will be a lifelong treasure for us. I highly recommend Cristina, especially for families traveling with young children!
author: FarAway46623608865

title: A Wonderful Experience for a Solo Traveler
text:
As a solo traveler, I had such a wonderful experience with the photographer. She was very friendly and welcoming, and I felt like I had a personal guide with me throughout the experience. She was very conversational, spoke English very well, and made me feel comfortable right away. By the end, it felt like I had already made a new friend!

The photos turned out amazing, and there was a very good selection to choose from. I’m really happy with the whole experience and would definitely recommend her to anyone, especially solo travelers. Thank you for the wonderful memories! ❤️📸
